## Experience

- UVic Satellite Design, Software Engineer (Sep 2026 to present): SPI telemetry and video pipeline across an nRF5340, a Raspberry Pi, and a host PC using FreeRTOS, Python, and C
- Aeternum Corp, Software Developer (May to Jul 2026, Edmonton, AB, remote): permission-first RAG memory system with FastAPI and TypeScript, a batched dashboard API that cut latency by 70%, and a React Native app
- ProperSeer, Frontend Developer (May to Sep 2025, Calgary, AB, remote): React and Redux dashboards, with a 20% page load improvement from memoization and prefetching

## Projects

- MarketQuad: student marketplace for UVic (Next.js, React Native, Supabase, TypeScript) at https://market-quad.com
- Benny: receipt parsing and grocery budget tracker (React Native, Spring Boot, Gemini API, GCP)
- uEyes: computer vision app for the Google AI Hackathon that describes surroundings with audio (React, FastAPI, WebSockets, Firebase, GCP)
